turns.user: my dumbbells only go up to 24kg each and bench is getting easy, should I just go to 40kg
turns.reply:
Whoa, jumping from 24kg to 40kg per hand is a massive 32kg total jump! That is a fast track to injuring your shoulder tissue. 

Since you've almost topped out your set at home, try adding a 3-second pause at the bottom of each rep instead. This extra time under tension forces the muscle to work twice as hard without needing heavier iron, though we have other options too.

Are you training at home with that fixed set, or do you have access to a gym with heavier weights? 🏋️

turns.user: so what do I actually do next week
turns.reply:
Stick with the 24kg dumbbells next week, but change how you perform the reps. 

Slow down each descent to 3 seconds, pause for 2 full seconds with the dumbbells right at chest level, then press up. 

That extra time under tension creates the same muscular stimulus as a much heavier weight, without putting your shoulder joints at risk. 

Want me to update the tempo notes on your bench press for next week so it's right there on your session screen?
